links.outcome: e-CTA LVO detection accuracy on local consecutive cases versus consultant neuroradiologist ground truth
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.78 (95% CI 0.64-0.88), specificity 0.93, PPV 0.5 (0.42-0.58), NPV 0.98; error rate 9% (52/584) at 9% LVO prevalence.
links.quote: We demonstrated that PPV of e-CTA is poor in consecutive cases in a real-world NHS setting.

links.outcome: Predictive values at local low prevalence of LVO
links.effect: With LVO prevalence 9% (n=50), PPV was only 0.5 (0.42-0.58) despite specificity 0.93, showing clinical utility may be overstated.
links.quote: We hypothesized that in real world use where prevalence is low, its clinical utility may be overstated.

screen.reason: Retrospective service evaluation of commercially deployed Brainomix e-CTA software across consecutive clinical cases in an NHS hospital to assess real-world diagnostic performance and failure modes.
